notes: ἕως οὗ is one aligned unit on the single word 'until', on the model of rule 50's ἕως ἄν → till; splitting it would leave one token with no English word, and rule 39's test keeps the unit aligned.
Μηδενί takes 'to no man' with the case preposition riding along (rule 21) and heads on 'no', the supplied 'man' being the generic completion (rules 17, 69).

νεκρῶν is substantival and takes the supplied determiner itself (rule 58); the genitive τοῦ ἀνθρώπου has no English determiner, so its article is unrepresented and 'of' stays with the noun (rules 21, 23).
